newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls three cts/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator falls three cts/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator fell by three cents to 557 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Geelong on Tuesday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mixed, with 19 micron three percent cheaper, 20 micron 1.5 percent cheaper and 22/25 microns 0.5 percent dearer.
Merino skirtings were also cheaper while crossbreds were mixed, with 27 micron up to one percent cheaper and 28 micron slightly dearer while 2930/31 microns were one percent dearer.
In cardings, locks and crutchings were generally unchanged.
Japanese and Chinese trade was dominant with good support from Taiwan and Western Europe.
Of the 24,001 bales on offer, 9.5 percent were passed in.
Sales continue tomorrow in Sydney, Geelong and Fremantle with about 35,000 bales on offer.
